channel.title: Marijuana News -- ScienceDaily
channel.description: Marijuana research. Read the latest news about the effects of marijuana, including cannabis use and health, medical marijuana and more.

item.title: Cannabis users were twice as likely to commit violence, review finds
item.description: A systematic review of 30 studies found that people who used cannabis were about twice as likely to be violent towards others, with the strongest link among young men and frequent users.

item.title: Frequent cannabis users wake up with their 'stress hormone' already elevated
item.description: People who use cannabis daily have higher cortisol levels on waking than non-users, a new study shows.

item.title: Is cannabis safe after 65?
item.description: Older adults are the fastest-growing group of cannabis users, but research on how it interacts with common medications is scarce.
